<p>Instantly purge resources that use Cache Keys via the <a href="/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/">Cloudflare API</a>. If you use <a href="/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/#purge-cached-content-by-url">Cloudflare's Purge by URL</a>, include the headers and query strings that are in your custom Cache Key.</p>
<p>Currently, it is not possible to purge a URL stored through Cache API that uses a custom cache key set by a Worker. Instead, use a <a href="/cache/how-to/cache-rules/settings/#cache-key">custom key created by Cache Rules</a>. Alternatively, purge your assets using purge everything, purge by tag, purge by host or purge by prefix.</p>
<p>To instantly purge by <code>device_type</code>, <code>geo</code>, or <code>lang</code> use <code>CF-Device-Type</code>, <code>CF-IPCountry</code> or <code>accept-language</code>, respectively. <a href="/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/#purge-cached-content-by-tag-host-or-prefix">Purge by Tag / Host</a> and <a href="/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/#purge-all-cached-content">Purge Everything</a> are not impacted by the use of custom Cache Keys.</p>
<h2 id="purge-by-device-type">Purge by device type</h2>
<p>For a Cache Key based on device type, purge the asset by passing the <code>CF-Device-Type</code> header with the API purge request (valid headers include mobile, desktop, and tablet).</p>
<p>Refer to the example API request below to instantly purge all mobile assets on the root webpage.</p>
<pre class="nb-api-request"><code class="language-bash">curl --request POST \&#10;  --url https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/purge_cache \&#10;  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \&#10;  --data &#x27;{&#10;  &quot;files&quot;: [&#10;    {&#10;      &quot;url&quot;: &quot;http://my.website.com/&quot;,&#10;      &quot;headers&quot;: {&#10;        &quot;CF-Device-Type&quot;: &quot;mobile&quot;&#10;      }&#10;    }&#10;  ]&#10;}&#x27;</code></pre>
<h2 id="purge-by-geo">Purge by geo</h2>
<p>Instantly purge resources for a location-based Cache Key by specifying the two-letter country code. Spain is used in the example below.</p>
<pre class="nb-api-request"><code class="language-bash">curl --request POST \&#10;  --url https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/purge_cache \&#10;  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \&#10;  --data &#x27;{&#10;  &quot;files&quot;: [&#10;    {&#10;      &quot;url&quot;: &quot;http://my.website.com/&quot;,&#10;      &quot;headers&quot;: {&#10;        &quot;CF-IPCountry&quot;: &quot;ES&quot;&#10;      }&#10;    }&#10;  ]&#10;}&#x27;</code></pre>
<h2 id="purge-by-language">Purge by language</h2>
<p>For a Cache Key based on language, purge the asset by passing the <code>accept-language</code> header. Refer to the example API request below to instantly purge all assets in Chinese (PRC).</p>
<pre class="nb-api-request"><code class="language-bash">curl --request POST \&#10;  --url https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/purge_cache \&#10;  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \&#10;  --data &#x27;{&#10;  &quot;files&quot;: [&#10;    {&#10;      &quot;url&quot;: &quot;http://my.website.com/&quot;,&#10;      &quot;headers&quot;: {&#10;        &quot;accept-language&quot;: &quot;zh-CN&quot;&#10;      }&#10;    }&#10;  ]&#10;}&#x27;</code></pre>
